metadata.title: Suburban Backyard Portrait with Cinderblock Wall

retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body portrait of a tattooed figure standing on a wicker chair against a textured cinderblock wall in harsh daylight.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast outdoor photograph featuring a person with extensive arm and leg tattoos, viewed from behind, standing on an upturned wicker chair. They are positioned against a large, grey cinderblock wall under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. A garden hose is held in one hand, with water trickling down, creating a long shadow on the wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a repetitive grid of cinderblocks
Long diagonal shadow cast by the subject and hose onto the wall
Contrast between the organic human form and the rigid masonry
Vertical alignment of the subject, chair, and background palm tree
coreInvariants: Grey cinderblock wall spanning the horizontal frame
Harsh, direct sunlight creating deep shadows
Subject viewed from a rear perspective

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame, standing on a base element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The upturned grey wicker chair serves as the physical and visual base for the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical line of the subject up from the chair, then follows the diagonal shadow and the garden hose back down to the wet ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the expanse of the cinderblock wall and the open sky above it.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey (cinderblock wall and wicker chair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with natural, earthy saturation levels.

letterConstructionRules: Condensed proportions for the main warning text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Standardized block lettering for regulatory compliance appearance

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black and white rectangular badge

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for a warning label.
Standard professional sans-serif for regulatory-style graphics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a person with tattoos from behind, wearing a white tank top and denim shorts, standing on a wicker chair in front of a grey cinderblock wall in a sunny backyard with a garden hose.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small black and white rectangular 'Parental Advisory' style badge in the bottom right corner using a bold condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the cinderblock wall the primary background?
Is the lighting harsh with distinct shadows?
Is the text badge in the bottom right corner?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent shadow direction from the sun
Ensure the wicker texture of the chair is visible
Verify the cinderblock grid is straight and parallel
Confirm the text badge is legible and correctly positioned
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person with Tattoos] + Action [Standing on Chair] + Setting [Cinderblock Wall Backyard] + Lighting [Harsh Midday Sun] + Graphic [Corner Advisory Badge]
